title: BPP execution_permit_consume request (DESIGN.md §13.1, §14.8; registry R34 runtime)
description: Mutation (meta required). One-shot consumption of an authorized ActIntent by the trusted host effect service bound to the exact prepared host Effect (R34): the host durably creates its local Effect with the same stable_execution_key first, then calls with that key, its exact host effect, the Byom intent, subject, disclosure, budget, driver audience, and both current fences (§13.1 steps 3–4; byom_fence_epoch and host_fence_epoch are the derived dual-fence names — gap note G37). Byom atomically rechecks charter, standing, Mandate, decisions, dependencies, ceilings, expiry, and fences; inserts MandateUse once; and returns one immutable ExecutionConsumptionReceipt (§13.1 step 5). Repeating the same canonical request and key returns the same receipt; a changed request conflicts (idempotency_mismatch); a different key cannot consume the same one-shot decision or exhausted ceiling (§13.1 step 6) — gap note G37.

stable_execution_key.description: The one-shot key minted at preparation; the host Effect carries the same key (§13.1).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

class.description: Digest class per the §14.2 table; substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_id.description: Key id for keyed classes (raw HMAC keys and per-object salts are never part of a DigestRef).

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef (§14.2): every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash.

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2). Required on every mutation; update operations additionally supply expected_revision (registry rule enforced in code, not expressible here).
